_doc: Case studies. Key = the case study page slug (or a short id for PDFs without a page). 'hub' holds the tile shown on /cases-ai-marketing-strategy/ (section, title, sector, market, summary, cover) taken from the Leadpages hub. After a visitor submits the case-study Typeform, /thank-you-case-study/?cs=<key> starts the Drive download automatically. PDFs stay on Google Drive (434 MB in total, one file is 140 MB, above GitHub's 100 MB limit); the folder must stay 'Anyone with the link: Viewer'.
